identityRule: The preserved Refined Dive and Classic black-and-white animations define the character and motion language for Work, Compose, Idle, and Alert. Sonar is retained. Surface Spout is a separate Image Gen state grounded in Dive frame 1 and frozen four-sheet provenance. The blue static-logo direction is explicitly excluded.

identityReferences.role: primary image-generation reference; only the Dive and Classic rows are identity anchors

imageGeneration.runtimeUse: The studies are composition references only. No provider pixels are copied into runtime assets.
imageGeneration.transparencyFact: Every accepted pose study is an RGB image on a white background with no alpha channel. Provider transparency is not claimed. Runtime WebP and PNG assets are independently redrawn by the deterministic Pillow RGBA pipeline.

Input images: Image 1 is a motion contact sheet. Use ONLY the first two rows, REFINED DIVE and CLASSIC, as the character identity and visual-language reference. Ignore the blue fish-like rows below them.

Primary request: create one clean WORK action key pose of the same tiny black whale character from those first two rows, shown in full-body side view driving forward with a strong living C-curve through the torso and a long flexible tail stock.

Subject: small black ink whale silhouette with a blunt rounded whale head, tapered torso, very long narrow caudal peduncle, two broad horizontal flukes, one small swept pectoral fin, tiny white eye; include one restrained waterline/splash or ink-speed accent like the first two animations.
Style/medium: minimal hand-inked black-and-white silhouette, slightly organic edges, faithful to the first two rows; not a polished corporate logo.
Composition/framing: one whale only, centered with generous white margin, whole body visible, facing right.
Color palette: pure black and white only.
Constraints: must read as the same character as the first two rows at thumbnail size; dynamic whole-body bend; no text, no labels, no watermark.

Avoid: any blue or navy; DeepSeek official blue static icon; generic fish, tuna, shark, humpback realism, dorsal fin, short forked fish tail, thick oval mascot body, complex fin texture, gradients, gray, 3D, multiple frames, sprite sheet.
